settings.text: The Essence of Wellness, Inspired by Sanskrit Wisdom

settings.heading: Our story
settings.text: TATTVVA® embodies the ancient Sanskrit concept of "Tattva" - the true essence of nature. We transform carefully selected dry fruits, nuts, and natural ingredients into wholesome snacks that nourish, energize, and inspire healthier living.

settings.title: TATTVVA® Vision
settings.text: To become India's most trusted natural wellness food brand, inspiring a global movement towards healthier living through authentic, nutritious, and sustainably crafted food solutions.

settings.title: TATTVVA® Mission
settings.text: To create premium nutrient-dense foods, upholding the philosophy of Tattva by preserving the true essence and nutritional value of every ingredient.

settings.title: TATTVVA® Brand Purpose
settings.text: To bring the true essence of nature into everyday nutrition, empowering people to live healthier, happier, and more mindful lives through pure, wholesome, and authentic foods.

settings.heading: Core values
settings.items: Quality, Integrity, Innovation, Transparency, Customer First, Sustainability
